dialogues.speaker: Dongdong
dialogues.text: Yeeeaaah! I beat someone from outside our village! I'm gonna tell Daddy all about this one. He'll be so pleased!

dialogues.speaker: Dongdong
dialogues.text: Wow, you're invincible... Don't tell anyone you beat me, though. Especially not anyone from the Crux Fleet!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good luck, you can do it.

dialogues.speaker: Dongdong
dialogues.text: Thanks! You're one of the few people in the village to encourage me!

dialogues.speaker: Dongdong
dialogues.text: All the other villagers say I'll never become a big hero like my dad, because I don't drink my milk...

dialogues.speaker: Dongdong
dialogues.text: But who says heroes have to drink milk? That stuff tastes so weird.

dialogues.speaker: Dongdong
dialogues.text: Still, it'd be a shame to let it all go to waste... Why don't you take it instead?

dialogues.speaker: Dongdong
dialogues.text: Wow! You look like a traveler, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Dongdong
dialogues.text: Wow, cool! You must have been to sooo many cool places and seen sooo many cool things!

dialogues.speaker: Dongdong
dialogues.text: My dad's a sailor with The Crux! They travel all around the world and go on adventures every day. He's a real hero!

dialogues.speaker: Dongdong
dialogues.text: He doesn't come home much, but he always sends me letters about the coolest, most exciting things that happen on his journeys. Hee-hee!

dialogues.speaker: Dongdong
dialogues.text: When I'm older, I'm gonna join The Crux Fleet too! Then I'll be able to see all that stuff for myself! How cool will that be!?

dialogues.speaker: Dongdong
dialogues.text: Bye-bye! Have a cool adventure, just like my dad!
